purpose: Collect passive parent-prefix hidden states for retained work items when they first enter the current cumulative-NLL Top5, without changing P3 search semantics or adding model forwards.

observational_change_only.representation: last-token parent-prefix hidden state associated with each retained child when that child first enters global cumulative-NLL Top5

requirements: hidden capture and baseline normalized search results are identical
capture work_item_ids unique and subset of retained work
all captured first-entry NLL ranks are in 1..5

gate1_gpu_smoke.cohort: exact deterministic 3-output P3 smoke: one PROFILE_S, one PROFILE_M, one PROFILE_L
requirements: candidate_pool_snapshot/hash parity with frozen P3 reference at R256/R512/R768/R1024
model_forwards exactly identical to P3 reference per cell
useful/replay forward counts exactly identical to P3 reference per cell
hidden metadata and NPZ work_item_id order exactly aligned
prefix/parent lineage joins to retained telemetry
wall-time overhead <=15% versus same frozen P3 smoke outputs

gate2_gpu_collection.archive_policy: Hidden tensors may remain external if repository-size policy requires it, but path, byte size and SHA256 must be frozen. Metadata/receipts/hashes must be committed. Never claim remote raw archive unless actually present.

postfreeze_probe.gold_labels: join only after Gate2 freeze using existing exact prefix-hash Gold labeling contract
postfreeze_probe.candidate_set: NLL Top5 states; Gold-outside-Top5 states count as selector-unreachable in overall metrics
representation: training-only PCA to 64 components independently for each of layers 11,23,35
append frozen scalar Top5 telemetry features used in CPU audit
postfreeze_probe.validation: 12-way leave-one-task-out; PCA/scaler fitted on training tasks only
postfreeze_probe.secondary_diagnostics: single-layer probes for layers 11,23,35; not eligible for model selection
primary_metrics: conditional Top1 given Gold in Top5
authorization_gate: zero catastrophic tasks where DeltaTop1<=-0.05 and DeltaMRR<=-0.05
